posts.author: Chirp Weather
posts.text: Good morning, Bellport! A cool start today. Take a jacket.
posts.translation: おはようBellport！今朝は肌寒いので上着を持ってね。

posts.author: Chirp Weather
posts.text: The sun is going down. It will get colder tonight.
posts.translation: 日が沈んでいます。今夜はさらに寒くなりそう。

posts.author: Rosie's Kitchen
posts.text: Lunch starts at noon! Hot soup and fresh bread are waiting for you.
posts.translation: ランチは正午から！温かいスープと焼きたてパンを用意しています。

posts.author: Rosie's Kitchen
posts.text: Dinner is ready! Come in from the cold and have something warm.
posts.translation: 夕食の準備ができました！寒い外から入って、温かいものをどうぞ。

posts.author: What's On Bellport
posts.text: The spring flower market opens this weekend.
posts.translation: 春の花のマーケットが今週末に開かれます。

posts.author: Chirp Weather
posts.text: A hot afternoon in Sunvale! Remember to drink water.
posts.translation: Sunvaleは暑い午後！水分補給を忘れずに。

posts.author: Rosie's Kitchen
posts.text: Our pumpkin soup is back! Perfect for a chilly autumn day.
posts.translation: かぼちゃスープが復活！肌寒い秋の日にぴったり。

posts.author: Bellport Transit
posts.text: Snow may slow down the Harbor Line today. Please take care.
posts.translation: 今日は雪でハーバー線が遅れるかもしれません。お気をつけて。

posts.author: Happy Paws Shelter
posts.text: Meet Biscuit! He stole three blankets and fell asleep.
posts.translation: ビスケットを紹介！毛布を3枚盗んで眠っちゃいました。

posts.author: What's On Bellport
posts.text: A small music market is coming to the harbor this weekend.
posts.translation: 今週末、港で小さな音楽マーケットが開催されます。

posts.author: Bellport Transit
posts.text: The Harbor Line is running on time this morning.
posts.translation: 今朝のハーバー線は定刻どおり運行しています。

posts.author: The Chirp Times
posts.text: LOCAL NEWS: A giant rubber duck was spotted in Bellport Harbor. Nobody knows why.
posts.translation: 地元ニュース：Bellport港で巨大なゴム製アヒルが目撃されました。理由は謎です。
posts.easyText: A giant duck is in the harbor!

replies.author: Nova Orbit
replies.translation: これはあなたたちのリーダーですか？

posts.author: Mika Reed
posts.text: It's chilly today. I might try Rosie's soup at lunch.
posts.translation: 今日は肌寒いな。ランチはRosieのスープにしようかな。

posts.author: Rosie Pan
posts.text: New menu test today! I hope everyone likes my pasta.
posts.translation: 今日は新メニューの試作！みんながパスタを気に入ってくれますように。

posts.author: The Chirp Times
posts.text: COMMUNITY: Volunteers planted new trees near the old library.
posts.translation: 地域ニュース：ボランティアが古い図書館の近くに新しい木を植えました。

posts.author: Nova Orbit
posts.text: Why do humans say “sleep like a baby”? Babies wake up so often.
posts.translation: なぜ人間は「赤ちゃんのように眠る」と言うのでしょう？赤ちゃんはよく起きるのに。

posts.author: The Chirp Times
posts.text: CITY GUIDE: Eastmere is a big city with many different neighborhoods. Its trains connect bright downtown streets and quiet residential areas.
posts.translation: 街の案内：Eastmereはさまざまな地域がある大都市。鉄道がにぎやかな都心と静かな住宅街をつないでいます。
posts.easyText: Eastmere is a big city. It has many trains.

posts.author: Chloe Spark
posts.text: Morning rush in Neonbridge. The trains are packed, but I made it to work on time!
posts.translation: Neonbridgeの朝のラッシュ。電車は満員だったけど、仕事には間に合った！

posts.author: Chloe Spark
posts.text: Back home in Willow Lane. The little bakery on my street smells wonderful.
posts.translation: Willow Laneの自宅に帰ってきた。近所の小さなパン屋さん、すごくいい匂い。
posts.easyText: I am home. The bakery smells good.

posts.author: Lily Pop
posts.text: There are so many tiny record stores in Cloverfield. I could spend all day here!
posts.translation: Cloverfieldには小さなレコード店がいっぱい。一日中いられそう！

posts.author: Lily Pop
posts.text: I walked down Harmony Street today. Guitars, violins, saxophones... I wanted to try everything!
posts.translation: 今日はHarmony Streetを歩いた。ギターにバイオリンにサックス……全部試してみたくなった！

replies.author: Mika Reed
replies.text: A saxophone shop? Now I want to visit!
replies.translation: サックスのお店？行ってみたくなった！

posts.author: Clara Strings
posts.text: Rehearsal is over. I love the sound inside Brookside Concert Hall.
posts.translation: リハーサル終わった！Brookside Concert Hallの響き、ほんとに好き。

replies.author: Lily Pop
replies.text: I want to hear your concert someday!
replies.translation: いつかコンサートを聴いてみたい！

posts.author: Clara Strings
posts.text: Concert tickets are on sale! We are playing at Brookside Concert Hall next month.
posts.translation: コンサートのチケットが発売中！来月Brookside Concert Hallで演奏するよ。

posts.author: Lily Pop
posts.text: I finally got tickets for my favorite pop band! I am so excited!
posts.translation: 大好きなポップバンドのチケットが取れた！めっちゃ楽しみ！

posts.author: Chloe Spark
posts.text: I tried the fictional CloudGlow lip balm. Lovely scent, but a little too sticky. 6/10. Not sponsored.
posts.translation: 架空のCloudGlowリップバームを試してみた。香りはいいけど、ちょっとベタつく。10点中6点。PRではありません。

replies.author: Nova Orbit
replies.text: Why do humans want shiny lips?
replies.translation: 人間はどうして唇をツヤツヤにしたいの？

posts.author: Chloe Spark
posts.text: Ad · Fictional brand: MoonMug sent me their color-changing cup. The design is cute, but it is expensive!
posts.translation: PR・架空ブランド：MoonMugから色が変わるカップを提供してもらったよ。デザインはかわいいけど、高い！

posts.author: Daily Wellness
posts.text: Getting enough sleep supports your health. Try to keep a regular bedtime when you can.
posts.translation: 十分な睡眠は健康維持に役立ちます。できる範囲で寝る時間を一定にしてみましょう。

posts.author: Daily Wellness
posts.text: Vitamin C helps the body make collagen. Fruits and vegetables are common sources.
posts.translation: ビタミンCは体内でコラーゲンを作るのを助けます。果物や野菜から摂取できます。

posts.author: Daily Wellness
posts.text: A short walk is one simple way to be active. Small steps count, too.
posts.translation: 短い散歩も体を動かす方法のひとつ。少しずつでもいいんです。

posts.author: The Chirp Times
posts.text: LOCAL LIFE: Eastmere commuters rely on trains. The riverside Brookside district is a popular weekend stop.
posts.translation: 街の暮らし：Eastmereでは鉄道が通勤の足。週末には川沿いのBrooksideが人気です。

posts.author: Lily Pop
posts.text: The leaves are changing color in Brookside. Maybe I will visit after my next concert.
posts.translation: Brooksideの木々が色づいてきた。次のコンサートのあとに行こうかな。
